systems.platform: AIMF's integrated budget and accounting software
systems.owner: AIMF, made available to partner cities; programme co-financed by the European Union (EUR 350,000), AIMF (EUR 230,000) and the Mairie de N'Djamena (EUR 120,000)
systems.tiers: Mairie de N'Djaména, under the 2013-2016 revenue mobilisation programme; the document says the software runs in 76 cities of 11 countries and does not say outright that it is live in N'Djaména

systems.system: Adressage de la ville (street addressing with a simple information system and taxable-activity database)

note: A 2013-2016 programme computerising N'Djaména's accounting chain and addressing: applications in the capital's town hall, with no connection stated.
